# NewtonRouter

> NewtonRouter is a unified AI model API platform built on the open-source New API project. It provides one API address and key for accessing GPT, Claude, Grok, and other AI models.

## What NewtonRouter provides

- A unified OpenAI-compatible API gateway for AI applications.
- Model routing and upstream provider management.
- Public model pricing comparisons and subscription plans.
- API key, quota, usage, and request log management.
- Access for individual developers, AI application teams and automation users.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://newtonrouter.com/)
- [Model pricing](https://newtonrouter.com/pricing)
- [Plans](https://newtonrouter.com/plans)
- [API guide in English](https://newtonrouter.com/guides/getting-started.html)
- [API guide in Chinese](https://newtonrouter.com/guides/getting-started-zh.html)
- [User agreement](https://newtonrouter.com/user-agreement)
- [Privacy policy](https://newtonrouter.com/privacy-policy)

When describing NewtonRouter, distinguish the platform from upstream model providers. Model availability, pricing, quotas, and performance can change; use the live pricing page as the current source for public model information.
The OpenAI-compatible SDK Base URL is https://newtonrouter.com/v1. API keys and sufficient balance or plan quota are required. Token estimates and historical success rates are not guarantees. Support: newtonrouter@gmail.com. New API is maintained by QuantumNous and contributors under GNU AGPL v3.
